stem: A pharmacy partially fills a Schedule II prescription repeatedly for a terminally ill patient under the federal special pathway. Which documentation principles apply? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Record the quantity dispensed with each partial filling
Document the patient as terminally ill for this special pathway
End further partial dispensing from the prescription when it is discontinued, even before 60 days have elapsed.
Continue partial fillings beyond 60 days solely because unused quantity remains
Record the date of each partial filling

explanation.core_reasoning: The special terminal/LTCF pathway requires traceable records for each partial and does not convert the remainder into an unlimited refill.

choice_analysis.B: The special status must be indicated in the record/prescription framework.
choice_analysis.C: Discontinuation ends use of the prescription sooner than the outer 60-day period.
choice_analysis.E: Each partial dispensing must be documented.

related_facts: The prescription may end earlier if discontinued.
explanation.mpje_trap: Focusing on quantity remaining while ignoring the special record and time limits.

reasoning_steps: Identify terminally ill C-II partial filling
Apply per-dispensing records and special-status documentation
